value.rationale: The primary paper is about dynamic belief contraction, so repetition and update order are intrinsic structural questions rather than arbitrary finite tests. The theorem gives a complete simplification law for repeated factual contractions and an exact classical criterion for pairwise order independence, together with a minimal two-world failure pattern. These facts directly reduce sequential-update reasoning in HPAL and delineate where genuine order effects first arise.
